title: Port Scanning
description: Ports are like numbered doors on a computer that allow specific services in and out. For example, door 80 is for websites, and door 443 is for secure websites. A port scan shows which doors are currently open and waiting for connections.
tips: Open ports on public internet IP addresses can be a security risk if not intended.
If a service (like a web server) isn't working, check if its port is actually open here.
Ensure your firewall blocks ports you don't need.
